player_prompt.intro:
Nge ye Mwana {player_id} ({role}) na ngola {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies.
- Na ngola mosi, tala [heads] toi [tails] (toi [h], [t]).
- Soki luka na yo, Mwana 0 muna ngola; nioso Mwana 1 muna.
Tala na luka na '[heads]' toi '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mwana 0 kaka{choice0}; Mwana 1 kaka{choice1}. Match -> Mwana 0 muna
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.

outcome.p0_wins: Muntu ya bo ponaka na kubula nsaka yai nungaka mingi.
outcome.p1_wins: Muntu ya ntete kubakaka bakonsi mingi.
outcome.draw: Nsuka-nsuka, bo me sala nsaka ya kuzenga maboko na ntu.
